title: shamir-secret-sharing states the sss README's 255-share and 113-byte-share limits as a tagged DOC fact, not only in a table cell
goal: kb/public/auth/shamir-secret-sharing.md has a DOC fact line, anchored in kb/public/_anchors.csv, giving the sss README's limits (at most 255 shares, 64-byte secrets, 113-byte shares) so rag.py facts and factdiff see them, where today they sit only in the untagged tool table row (line 38). Found by the SP-tcis5f23 review (S4).

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','facts','auth/shamir-secret-sharing','--tag','DOC','--format','detailed'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(o.returncode!=0 or not any('255' in l and '113' in l for l in o.stdout.splitlines()))

import csv,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts; ks=[kbfacts.fact_key(u['text']) for u in kbfacts.units('public') if u['path'].endswith('/shamir-secret-sharing.md') and '255' in u['text'] and '113' in u['text'] and '[DOC' in u['text']]; rows={r['fact'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_anchors.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['status']=='located'}; sys.exit(0 if ks and all(k in rows for k in ks) else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 8 of 15, "Content fixes: auth, encryption and Linux hardening articles and answers"): a lookup returns a wrong or missing fact until it is fixed, which the held-out answer-rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm reads. Premise run at planning: rag.py facts auth/shamir-secret-sharing --tag DOC --format detailed shows no line holding 255 and 113 (they sit only in table row 38), and the article has no row in _anchors.csv; both checks exit 1. The first draft check read the default 160-character cut of facts output, so it now reads --format detailed.
